I S. 2460, made by the Bundesanstalt für Finanzdienstleistungsaufsicht under §§ 26 to 30 KAGB, with the regulation transferring the power to BaFin (Eingangsformel); full text page with the Vollzitat and the Stand (Zuletzt geändert durch Art. 1 V v. 28.7.2022 BAnz AT 29.07.2022 V2); entry into force read in § 8

titles.de: Verordnung zur Konkretisierung der Verhaltensregeln und Organisationsregeln nach dem Kapitalanlagegesetzbuch (Kapitalanlage-Verhaltens- und -Organisationsverordnung - KAVerOV)
titles.en: Regulation on Conduct and Organisation Rules under the Investment Code

payload.officialRef: Kapitalanlage-Verhaltens- und -Organisationsverordnung vom 16. Juli 2013 (BGBl. I S. 2460)
payload.implementsNote: Commission Directive 2010/43/EU on organisational requirements, conflicts of interest, conduct of business and risk management for UCITS management companies (the directive the regulation's footnote on Gesetze im Internet lists)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Treat fund investors fairly and confirm subscriptions and redemptions by the next business day
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kapitalanlage-Verhaltens- und -Organisationsverordnung (KAVerOV), BGBl. I S. 2460, § 2 Abs. 2 bis 4

titles.en: Treat fund investors fairly and confirm subscriptions and redemptions by the next business day

summaries.en: A management company of UCITS or retail AIFs must treat investors fairly and may not put the interests of one investor or group above those of others; unequal treatment in sharing a fund's profit or loss is a material disadvantage. It must give investors the information on each executed subscription or redemption on a durable medium at the latest on the first business day after execution, adding for retail investors the payment method, order type, number of units, unit price, value date and charges, and publish information on its order execution principles and material changes on its website.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish a summary of the voting rights strategy on the website
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kapitalanlage-Verhaltens- und -Organisationsverordnung (KAVerOV), BGBl. I S. 2460, § 3 Abs. 2

titles.en: Publish a summary of the voting rights strategy on the website

summaries.en: A management company of UCITS or retail AIFs must publish on its website a short description of the strategies it has drawn up for exercising the voting rights attached to the funds' assets, and give investors details of the measures taken under them free of charge on request.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Use capable staff and run a free, documented complaints procedure for fund investors
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kapitalanlage-Verhaltens- und -Organisationsverordnung (KAVerOV), BGBl. I S. 2460, § 4 Abs. 2 und 3

titles.en: Use capable staff and run a free, documented complaints procedure for fund investors

summaries.en: The management company may entrust tasks only to persons with the necessary skills, knowledge and experience, must make sure no one has so many tasks that they cannot do them thoroughly, and needs the resources and expertise to integrate sustainability risks. It must set up and apply effective and transparent procedures for handling investor complaints promptly, document each complaint and the measures taken, keep the procedure free for investors and describe it on its website free of charge.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Analyse an acquisition's effect on the fund's composition, liquidity and risk before buying
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kapitalanlage-Verhaltens- und -Organisationsverordnung (KAVerOV), BGBl. I S. 2460, § 5 Abs. 2

titles.en: Analyse an acquisition's effect on the fund's composition, liquidity and risk before buying

summaries.en: Before acquiring an asset for a UCITS or retail AIF, the management company must, as far as suits the asset, make forecasts and analyses of how the acquisition affects the fund's composition, liquidity and risk and return profile, based only on reliable and current data, taking sustainability risks into account and, where it considers them, the principal adverse impacts on sustainability factors under the Sustainable Finance Disclosure Regulation.

I S. 2483, made by the Bundesanstalt für Finanzdienstleistungsaufsicht under § 96 Abs. 4, § 106, § 120 Abs. 8, § 135 Abs. 11 and § 168 Abs. 8 KAGB, with the regulation transferring the power to BaFin (Eingangsformel); full text page with the Vollzitat and the Stand (Geändert durch Art. 18 Abs. 2 G v. 3.6.2021 I 1498); entry into force read in § 36

titles.de: Verordnung über Inhalt, Umfang und Darstellung der Rechnungslegung von Sondervermögen, Investmentaktiengesellschaften und Investmentkommanditgesellschaften sowie über die Bewertung der zu dem Investmentvermögen gehörenden Vermögensgegenstände (Kapitalanlage-Rechnungslegungs- und -Bewertungsverordnung - KARBV)
titles.en: Regulation on Accounting and Valuation under the Investment Code

payload.officialRef: Kapitalanlage-Rechnungslegungs- und -Bewertungsverordnung vom 16. Juli 2013 (BGBl. I S. 2483)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Make fund reports complete, accurate, unbiased and clear without referring to earlier reports
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kapitalanlage-Rechnungslegungs- und -Bewertungsverordnung (KARBV), BGBl. I S. 2483, § 3

titles.en: Make fund reports complete, accurate, unbiased and clear without referring to earlier reports

summaries.en: Reports of a fund by the management company, the depositary or the liquidator must be complete, accurate, free of arbitrariness and clearly laid out, so that investors get a full picture of the fund's actual position and development for their investment decisions and ongoing assessment, and must include events, decisions and factors that may materially affect its future. The extent of reporting must match the importance of the matters shown, and references to the content of earlier reports are not allowed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Draw up the fund's annual report with the set components, signed by management
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kapitalanlage-Rechnungslegungs- und -Bewertungsverordnung (KARBV), BGBl. I S. 2483, § 4, § 6 Abs. 1 und § 7

titles.en: Draw up the fund's annual report with the set components, signed by management

summaries.en: The management company is responsible for drawing up the annual report of each investment fund, including the valuations behind the statement of assets, with the components § 7 lists: activity report, overview and statement of assets with ISINs, income and expense statement, use of income, development of the fund, a three-year comparison, transactions no longer in the statement, the notes and the auditor's special opinion. Reports are signed by hand by the management at the end, and half-yearly reports of retail funds go to BaFin only through its electronic communication procedure.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep fund valuation separate from portfolio management and check the depositary's values
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kapitalanlage-Rechnungslegungs- und -Bewertungsverordnung (KARBV), BGBl. I S. 2483, § 26

titles.en: Keep fund valuation separate from portfolio management and check the depositary's values

summaries.en: Where the depositary values a UCITS with the management company's involvement, the company must check the values for plausibility, have anomalies cleared up and document that it does so. Within the company, valuation or the involvement in it must sit in a unit separated in the organisation from portfolio management up to management board level; valuation units between hedged item and hedge are not allowed in funds; and internal audit reviews regularly that these rules and the valuation rules are met.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Value fund assets at the last tradable price or by documented, regularly reviewed models
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Kapitalanlage-Rechnungslegungs- und -Bewertungsverordnung (KARBV), BGBl. I S. 2483, §§ 27 und 28

titles.en: Value fund assets at the last tradable price or by documented, regularly reviewed models

summaries.en: Assets admitted to or included in trading on an exchange or other organised market are valued at the last available tradable price that gives a reliable valuation, and whoever values them documents the criteria for treating market prices as accurate, reliable and current; indicative prices are not tradable prices. Other assets are valued at market value by a recognised and suitable model that is documented in detail and reviewed regularly against current market information, and a value supplied by an issuer, counterparty or other third party must be checked for plausibility and the check documented.

instruments.title: Add DerivateV, the German regulation on risk management and risk measurement for derivatives, securities lending and repos in investment funds (Derivateverordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Derivateverordnung (DerivateV), BGBl. I S. 2463, made by the Bundesanstalt für Finanzdienstleistungsaufsicht under § 197 Abs. 3, § 204 Abs. 3, § 106, § 120 Abs. 8, § 121 Abs. 4, § 135 Abs. 11 and § 136 Abs. 4 KAGB, with the regulation transferring the power to BaFin (Eingangsformel); full text page with the Vollzitat and the Stand (Zuletzt geändert durch Art. 11 G v. 9.4.2026 I Nr. 97); entry into force read in § 41

titles.de: Verordnung über Risikomanagement und Risikomessung beim Einsatz von Derivaten, Wertpapier-Darlehen und Pensionsgeschäften in Investmentvermögen nach dem Kapitalanlagegesetzbuch (Derivateverordnung - DerivateV)
titles.en: Derivatives Regulation for investment funds

obligations.title: Add the duty: Use derivatives only within the fund's investment character and permitted underlyings
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Derivateverordnung (DerivateV), BGBl. I S. 2463, § 2

titles.en: Use derivatives only within the fund's investment character and permitted underlyings

summaries.en: The use of derivatives, securities loans and repos may not change the investment character the Investment Code, the investment conditions and the sales documents describe, nor add material risk to the risk profile set out there. Except for other investment funds and special AIFs with fixed conditions, a management company may enter into derivatives only where the fund could acquire the underlyings or could have taken on the same risks through its permitted assets, and a derivative whose counterparty has discretion over the portfolio or the underlyings counts as outsourcing of portfolio management.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Measure the use of the fund's market risk limit at least daily and keep within it at all times
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Derivateverordnung (DerivateV), BGBl. I S. 2463, § 5, § 7 und § 15

titles.en: Measure the use of the fund's market risk limit at least daily and keep within it at all times

summaries.en: The management company must determine at least daily, or intraday where the strategy requires, how far the fund uses its market risk limit for derivatives, and comply with the limit at all times. It chooses on its own responsibility the qualified approach, under which the fund's potential market risk may never exceed twice that of its reference portfolio or 20 per cent of the fund's value, or the simple approach, under which the market risk exposure may never exceed the fund's value; it must use the qualified approach where the simple one does not capture all market risks adequately.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Document the choice of risk measurement approach and notify BaFin of any change
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Derivateverordnung (DerivateV), BGBl. I S. 2463, § 6

titles.en: Document the choice of risk measurement approach and notify BaFin of any change

summaries.en: The management company must document its choice between the simple and the qualified approach, and of the method within the qualified approach, with the assumptions behind it. It must notify BaFin without delay through BaFin's electronic communication procedure of any switch between the approaches or methods for a fund.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run stress tests on each fund at least monthly under a documented policy
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Derivateverordnung (DerivateV), BGBl. I S. 2463, §§ 28, 30 und 31

titles.en: Run stress tests on each fund at least monthly under a documented policy

summaries.en: The management company must stress test each fund for exceptionally large losses from unusual changes in value drivers and, where appropriate, test in reverse, integrate the results into risk management and take them into account in investment decisions. The tests are run at least monthly and whenever a change in the fund or the market may change their results materially, are adapted continuously and run in parallel once after any redesign, and follow a written policy and a programme for each fund, with every test, its result and any departure from the programme documented.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Send BaFin a yearly report on the derivatives used in each UCITS fund
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Derivateverordnung (DerivateV), BGBl. I S. 2463, § 38 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Send BaFin a yearly report on the derivatives used in each UCITS fund

summaries.en: For each UCITS the management company must prepare, as at the end of the calendar or financial year and at any time BaFin asks, a report on the derivatives and structured products with a derivative component used, with their types, risks, measurement method and purpose, the derivatives held at the reporting date with their exposure amounts for market, issuer and counterparty risk and the use of each limit; for open-ended retail AIFs and special AIFs it does so only on request. The report goes to BaFin without delay through its electronic communication procedure.

instruments.title: Add PAngV, the German regulation on price indications to consumers, including consumer credit (Preisangabenverordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Preisangabenverordnung (PAngV), BGBl. I S. 4921, made by the Bundesregierung, Bundesministerium für Wirtschaft und Energie and Bundesministerium der Finanzen (footnote to the title); full text page with the Vollzitat and the Stand (Zuletzt geändert durch Art. 3 G v. 19.10.2026 I Nr. 314); entry into force read in the footnote to the title

titles.de: Preisangabenverordnung (PAngV)
titles.en: Price Indication Regulation

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a price list for the main services offered to consumers
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Preisangabenverordnung (PAngV), BGBl. I S. 4921, § 12 und § 1 Abs. 3

titles.en: Keep a price list for the main services offered to consumers

summaries.en: A business that offers services to consumers must draw up a price list of its main services or its charging rates, including all elements and VAT, and display it on its premises and in any shop window, or keep it there for inspection where it is too long to display. This does not apply to services usually provided on a written individual offer or to services whose price indication another law or regulation specially governs, and every price indication must be clearly assigned to the offer, easy to see and read, and true and clear.

obligations.title: Add the duty: State the total cost of a consumer loan as the annual percentage rate
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Preisangabenverordnung (PAngV), BGBl. I S. 4921, § 16 und § 19

titles.en: State the total cost of a consumer loan as the annual percentage rate

summaries.en: A business that offers consumer loans must state as their price the total cost to the consumer as an annual percentage of the net loan amount, called the effective annual rate and calculated by the formula and assumptions in the annex. The total cost includes interest and all other known costs of the loan, such as brokerage, a required account and property valuation, but not default costs, optional insurance, land register fees or notary costs; where a required ancillary contract has costs that cannot be set in advance, the obligation to take it and the rate must be shown prominently. The same applies to paid deferred payment and other financial accommodation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the standard information and a representative example when advertising loans with cost figures
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Preisangabenverordnung (PAngV), BGBl. I S. 4921, § 17

titles.en: Give the standard information and a representative example when advertising loans with cost figures

summaries.en: All advertising for consumer loans must be fair and clear and may not raise false expectations about cost or the chance of getting a loan. Advertising with rates or cost figures must state clearly and prominently the lender or broker, the net loan amount, the borrowing rate and whether it is fixed or variable, the costs included and the effective annual rate, which is shown at least as prominently as any other rate, and where relevant the total amount, term and instalments, the land charge for property loans and a currency warning for foreign currency property loans. The figures come with an example based on a rate that at least two thirds of the resulting contracts are expected to reach or beat.

obligations.title: Add the duty: State the borrowing rate and charging period for a simple overdraft facility
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Preisangabenverordnung (PAngV), BGBl. I S. 4921, § 18

titles.en: State the borrowing rate and charging period for a simple overdraft facility

summaries.en: For an overdraft facility under § 504 Abs. 2 of the Civil Code, the lender states the borrowing rate per year and the interest charging period instead of the effective annual rate, where the period is not shorter than three months and the lender charges nothing but interest.

instruments.title: Add ImmoKWPLV, the German regulation setting guidelines for creditworthiness assessment in consumer residential property loans (Immobiliar-Kreditwürdigkeitsprüfungsleitlinien-Verordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Immobiliar-Kreditwürdigkeitsprüfungsleitlinien-Verordnung (ImmoKWPLV), BGBl. I S. 529, made by the Bundesministerium der Finanzen and Bundesministerium der Justiz und für Verbraucherschutz under § 505e BGB and § 18a Abs. 10a KWG (Eingangsformel); full text page with the Vollzitat and no Stand line (text as enacted); entry into force not read, the regulation naming only the day after its promulgation

titles.de: Verordnung zur Festlegung von Leitlinien zu den Kriterien und Methoden der Kreditwürdigkeitsprüfung bei Immobiliar-Verbraucherdarlehensverträgen (Immobiliar-Kreditwürdigkeitsprüfungsleitlinien-Verordnung - ImmoKWPLV)
titles.en: Regulation on Guidelines for Creditworthiness Assessment in Residential Property Lending

payload.implementsNote: Mortgage Credit Directive, Directive 2014/17/EU (named in the regulation's own footnote, "Diese Verordnung dient der Umsetzung der Richtlinie 2014/17/EU", and in the official note on EU law)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Base the creditworthiness forecast for a home loan on full information over the whole term
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Immobiliar-Kreditwürdigkeitsprüfungsleitlinien-Verordnung (ImmoKWPLV), BGBl. I S. 529, § 2 und § 3

titles.en: Base the creditworthiness forecast for a home loan on full information over the whole term

summaries.en: Before a consumer residential property loan, the lender must assess thoroughly, on necessary, sufficient and appropriate information on the borrower's income, spending and other financial and economic circumstances, whether the borrower is likely to meet the obligations under the contract, reaching a reasonably justifiable forecast from all relevant factors. The forecast period is the period over which the obligations fall due; the lender may assume the usual course of events unless there are concrete signs otherwise, and may depart from its standard rules to reflect the individual case.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Weigh likely future events in the assessment and count the home's value only as an extra factor
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Immobiliar-Kreditwürdigkeitsprüfungsleitlinien-Verordnung (ImmoKWPLV), BGBl. I S. 529, § 4

titles.en: Weigh likely future events in the assessment and count the home's value only as an extra factor

summaries.en: The lender must take into account the relevant factors, in particular future payment increases from negative amortisation or deferred payments, other regular spending and debts, rental income that is likely and sustainable, and other income, savings and assets. The value of the residential property financed may count only as an additional feature beside the factors the assessment mainly rests on; likely negative events such as lower income in retirement, a rise in the borrowing rate or exchange rate moves must be taken into account adequately; and where an amount falls due at the end of the term, the assessment covers the borrower's ability to repay it or to obtain a follow-on loan.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Repeat the creditworthiness assessment when the net loan amount rises by more than 10 per cent
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Immobiliar-Kreditwürdigkeitsprüfungsleitlinien-Verordnung (ImmoKWPLV), BGBl. I S. 529, § 6 und § 7

titles.en: Repeat the creditworthiness assessment when the net loan amount rises by more than 10 per cent

summaries.en: A significant increase of the net loan amount after the contract is concluded, which calls for a new creditworthiness assessment under § 505a Abs. 2 of the Civil Code and § 18a Abs. 2 of the Banking Act, as a rule exists only where the amount rises by more than 10 per cent. In the new assessment, and when refinancing a loan taken with another lender, the lender may take the borrower's payment record into account.

instruments.title: Add VglWebMV, the German regulation on reporting payment account data for the comparison website under the Payment Accounts Act (Vergleichswebsitemeldeverordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Vergleichswebsitemeldeverordnung (VglWebMV), BGBl. 2024 I Nr. 68, made by the Bundesanstalt für Finanzdienstleistungsaufsicht under § 19 Abs. 5 ZKG, with the regulation transferring the power to BaFin (Eingangsformel); full text page with the Vollzitat and no Stand line (text as enacted); entry into force not read, the regulation naming only the day after its promulgation

titles.de: Verordnung über die Meldungen zu Zahlungskonten für die Vergleichswebsite nach dem Zahlungskontengesetz (Vergleichswebsitemeldeverordnung - VglWebMV)
titles.en: Regulation on Reports for the Payment Account Comparison Website

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report each consumer payment account's details and comparison criteria for the comparison website
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Vergleichswebsitemeldeverordnung (VglWebMV), BGBl. 2024 I Nr. 68, § 2

titles.en: Report each consumer payment account's details and comparison criteria for the comparison website

summaries.en: A payment service provider must report, for each payment account it offers to consumers, its name and the name or branch under which it offers the account, its website, a contact for consumer reports, the product name, the date of the report and the comparison criteria and data the annex lists. Corrections of wrongly reported data are reported as well.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File comparison website data as one complete data set through BaFin's reporting platform
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Vergleichswebsitemeldeverordnung (VglWebMV), BGBl. 2024 I Nr. 68, § 4 und § 5

titles.en: File comparison website data as one complete data set through BaFin's reporting platform

summaries.en: The provider must combine all data on the accounts it offers, including updates and corrections of data shown on the website, in one uniform and complete data set and report it electronically through BaFin's reporting platform using the procedure provided. It must ensure the data are transmitted properly, follow the information and instructions BaFin publishes on the report, the channel and the data formats, and send no data beyond what the regulation requires.

instruments.title: Add EntschFinV, the German regulation on the financing of the Entschädigungseinrichtung deutscher Banken (Entschädigungseinrichtungs-Finanzierungsverordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Entschädigungseinrichtungs-Finanzierungsverordnung (EntschFinV), BGBl. titles.de: Verordnung über die Finanzierung der Entschädigungseinrichtung deutscher Banken GmbH (Entschädigungseinrichtungs-Finanzierungsverordnung - EntschFinV)
titles.en: Regulation on the Financing of the Compensation Scheme of German Banks

obligations.title: Add the duty: Make the one-off payment when newly assigned to the compensation scheme
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Entschädigungseinrichtungs-Finanzierungsverordnung (EntschFinV), BGBl. I S. 9, § 13

titles.en: Make the one-off payment when newly assigned to the compensation scheme

summaries.en: A CRR credit institution newly assigned to the Entschädigungseinrichtung deutscher Banken must make a one-off payment, calculated as § 14 sets out, in addition to its annual contribution. Institutions that already made such a payment under the earlier contribution regulations, and institutions formed by conversion from members that paid annual contributions in the year of admission, are exempt.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Send the compensation scheme audited accounts, supervisory reports and ratings by 30 June
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Entschädigungseinrichtungs-Finanzierungsverordnung (EntschFinV), BGBl. I S. 9, § 15 Abs. 1 bis 4

titles.en: Send the compensation scheme audited accounts, supervisory reports and ratings by 30 June

summaries.en: A member institution must confirm to the scheme that its report of covered deposits is factually and arithmetically correct, and by 30 June of each settlement year send the annual accounts of the last financial year ending before 1 March, its supervisory reports under Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/451 and its own funds overview as at that balance sheet date, the scheme's questionnaire, its statement of assets and income, and all current ratings relating to it. The accounts and the statement need an unqualified audit opinion; newly founded institutions are exempt, and institutions without covered deposits send only the accounts and the statement.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Back a payment commitment with unencumbered low-risk debt securities or cash
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Entschädigungseinrichtungs-Finanzierungsverordnung (EntschFinV), BGBl. I S. 9, § 26

titles.en: Back a payment commitment with unencumbered low-risk debt securities or cash

summaries.en: Collateral for a payment commitment that replaces part of the annual contribution may only be low-risk debt securities or cash, in the proportion the scheme may set, and must be available to and realisable by the scheme without any prior third-party rights or encumbrances. It is provided by full transfer to a securities account or account of the scheme or by pledge on an account of the institution held with an institution the scheme names or with the Deutsche Bundesbank.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell the compensation scheme at once of anything that could impair a payment commitment
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Entschädigungseinrichtungs-Finanzierungsverordnung (EntschFinV), BGBl. I S. 9, § 31 Abs. 1 und 2

titles.en: Tell the compensation scheme at once of anything that could impair a payment commitment

summaries.en: An institution that has taken on a payment commitment must notify the scheme without delay of all circumstances that could impair its ability to meet the commitment or the framework agreement on collateral, in particular downgrades in solicited ratings, material supervisory or business changes and a deterioration of the debt securities given as collateral.

instruments.title: Add GwGMeldV, the German regulation on the form and content of suspicious activity reports to the Financial Intelligence Unit (GwG-Meldeverordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, GwG-Meldeverordnung (GwGMeldV), BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 200, made by the Bundesministerium der Finanzen under § 45 Abs. 5 Satz 1 GwG (Eingangsformel); full text page with the Vollzitat and no Stand line (text as enacted); entry into force read in § 5

titles.de: Verordnung über die Form von und die erforderlichen Angaben in Meldungen an die Zentralstelle für Finanztransaktionsuntersuchungen nach § 43 Absatz 1 und § 44 des Geldwäschegesetzes (GwG-Meldeverordnung - GwGMeldV)
titles.en: Regulation on Suspicious Activity Reports under the Anti-Money Laundering Act

obligations.title: Add the duty: File suspicious activity reports through the Financial Intelligence Unit's electronic procedure
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, GwG-Meldeverordnung (GwGMeldV), BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 200, § 2

titles.en: File suspicious activity reports through the Financial Intelligence Unit's electronic procedure

summaries.en: An obliged entity must file its suspicious activity reports, and any later additions or corrections of form, through the electronic data processing procedure the Financial Intelligence Unit provides, as structured XML or in the fields the procedure offers, with attachments in a format the Unit sets that can be evaluated automatically and searched. Only when electronic reporting is temporarily impossible for technical reasons may it use the alternative channels the Unit announces on its website.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Include the reference, reasons, related reports and a statement of facts with due diligence data in each report
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, GwG-Meldeverordnung (GwGMeldV), BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 200, § 3

titles.en: Include the reference, reasons, related reports and a statement of facts with due diligence data in each report

summaries.en: Each report must contain the reporter's reference, the reference of a related earlier report and the Unit's file number for it, one or more of the reporting reasons the Unit offers, any criminal complaint or official information request on the matter, and for the financial sector obliged entities of § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 1 to 9 of the Act whether they have filed or intend to file a suspicious transaction and order report with BaFin under the Market Abuse Regulation. It must describe the facts that trigger the duty to report, including the data collected on the customer, persons acting for it and the beneficial owner and on the purpose of the relationship, give the details the annex lists where available and attach the retained records needed. Matters concerning different persons may be combined only where they are connected.

instruments.title: Add AWV, the German Foreign Trade and Payments Regulation with its reporting duties for capital and payment transactions (Außenwirtschaftsverordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Außenwirtschaftsverordnung (AWV), BGBl. I S. 2865, made by the Bundesregierung (and, for the parts made under § 12 Abs. 1 Satz 2 AWG, the Bundesministerium für Wirtschaft und Technologie) under § 12 Abs. 1 AWG with § 11 and the other sections of the AWG the Eingangsformel lists (Eingangsformel); full text page with the Vollzitat and the Stand (Zuletzt geändert durch Art. 1 V v. 14.10.2026 I Nr. 300); entry into force read in the Stand line of the full text page

titles.de: Außenwirtschaftsverordnung (AWV)
titles.en: Foreign Trade and Payments Regulation

payload.implementsNote: Directive (EU) 2024/242 and Directive (EU) 2025/290 (the directives the regulation's footnote on Gesetze im Internet lists)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report securities, interest, dividend and travel card payments with non-residents to the Bundesbank monthly
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Außenwirtschaftsverordnung (AWV), BGBl. I S. 2865, § 70, § 71 Abs. 6 und § 72 Abs. 1

titles.en: Report securities, interest, dividend and travel card payments with non-residents to the Bundesbank monthly

summaries.en: A German credit institution, financial services institution or investment firm must report to the Deutsche Bundesbank its payments for securities and financial derivatives it buys from or sells to non-residents for its own or a client's account, and payments on redeeming German securities, above 50,000 euros, the interest and dividends on German securities it pays to or receives from non-residents, and incoming and outgoing card payments in travel, with the data in Annexes 5 to 7 and the securities' ISIN and amount. The reports are filed electronically by the seventh working day of the following month.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the firm's own payments with non-residents above 50,000 euros to the Bundesbank
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Außenwirtschaftsverordnung (AWV), BGBl. I S. 2865, § 67 und § 71 Abs. 6

titles.en: Report the firm's own payments with non-residents above 50,000 euros to the Bundesbank

summaries.en: A resident must report to the Deutsche Bundesbank by the seventh working day of the following month the payments above 50,000 euros it receives from or makes to non-residents, including set-offs, direct debits, contributions in kind and transfers of crypto-assets, with the data in Annex 5 or 6 and the code of the underlying transaction from the Bundesbank's list. Payments for goods, for loans and deposits with an original term of up to twelve months and interest on foreign bonds and money market paper are not reported, nor payments a financial institution already reports under § 70.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report foreign subsidiaries, holdings of 10 per cent or more and foreign branches once a year
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Außenwirtschaftsverordnung (AWV), BGBl. I S. 2865, § 64 und § 71 Abs. 1

titles.en: Report foreign subsidiaries, holdings of 10 per cent or more and foreign branches once a year

summaries.en: A resident must report to the Deutsche Bundesbank once a year, by the last working day of the sixth month after its balance sheet date, the assets and selected positions of foreign enterprises in which it holds at least 10 per cent of shares or votes, of foreign enterprises held more than 50 per cent through its dependent foreign enterprises, and of its foreign branches and permanent establishments, with the data in Annex 2. No report is needed for an enterprise whose balance sheet total, or a branch whose assets, do not exceed 6 million euros.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not satisfy claims that EU sanctions regulations bar
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Außenwirtschaftsverordnung (AWV), BGBl. I S. 2865, § 82 Abs. 1

titles.en: Do not satisfy claims that EU sanctions regulations bar

summaries.en: It is an administrative offence, committed intentionally or negligently, to satisfy or grant a claim that the no-claims clauses of the EU sanctions regulations listed in § 82 Abs. 1 bar, among them Regulations (EU) No 267/2012, No 833/2014 and (EU) 2017/1509. A firm must therefore make sure it does not pay or honour such claims.

instruments.title: Add ImmoDarlSachkV, the German regulation on the competence of staff involved in granting consumer residential property loans (Immobiliar-Darlehensvergabe-Sachkunde-Verordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Immobiliar-Darlehensvergabe-Sachkunde-Verordnung (ImmoDarlSachkV), BGBl. titles.de: Verordnung über die Anforderungen an die Sachkunde der mit der Vergabe von Immobiliar-Verbraucherdarlehen befassten internen und externen Mitarbeiter (Immobiliar-Darlehensvergabe-Sachkunde-Verordnung - ImmoDarlSachkV)
titles.en: Regulation on the Competence of Staff Granting Residential Property Loans

obligations.title: Add the duty: Make sure staff granting home loans to consumers have and can evidence the required knowledge
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Immobiliar-Darlehensvergabe-Sachkunde-Verordnung (ImmoDarlSachkV), BGBl. I S. 972, § 1 und § 2

titles.en: Make sure staff granting home loans to consumers have and can evidence the required knowledge

summaries.en: The internal and external staff of a credit institution involved in granting consumer residential property loans must have appropriate theoretical and practical knowledge of the legal basis of such lending, the creditworthiness assessment, the relevant loan products and the ancillary services usually offered with them, property purchase including land registers, and the valuation of collateral. The knowledge must be evidenced by certificates, employer references, training records or other suitable means; the qualifications § 2 lists, such as a banking apprenticeship or a degree in economics, law or mathematics with relevant practice, count as evidence, as do equivalent qualifications from another EEA state.

instruments.title: Add PfandMeldeV, the German regulation on the periodic reports of Pfandbrief banks to BaFin (Pfandbrief-Meldeverordnung)
instruments.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Pfandbrief-Meldeverordnung (PfandMeldeV), BGBl. I S. 1614, made by the Bundesanstalt für Finanzdienstleistungsaufsicht (footnote to the title); full text page with the Vollzitat and no Stand line (text as enacted); entry into force read in the footnote to the title

titles.de: Verordnung über pfandbriefrechtliche Meldungen (Pfandbrief-Meldeverordnung - PfandMeldeV)
titles.en: Pfandbrief Reporting Regulation

payload.implementsNote: Covered Bond Directive, Directive (EU) 2019/2162 (named in the regulation's own footnote, "Diese Verordnung dient der weiteren Umsetzung von Artikel 21 der Richtlinie (EU) 2019/2162", and in the official note on EU law)

obligations.title: Add the duty: File the cross-class report and the reports for each Pfandbrief class the bank issues
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Pfandbrief-Meldeverordnung (PfandMeldeV), BGBl. I S. 1614, § 3

titles.en: File the cross-class report and the reports for each Pfandbrief class the bank issues

summaries.en: A Pfandbrief bank must file the cross-class report in Annex 2 and, for each class in which it carries on Pfandbrief business, the circulation and cover reports for that class in the annexes: Annexes 3 to 8 for mortgage, 9 to 14 for public sector, 15 to 19 for ship and 20 to 24 for aircraft Pfandbriefe. It is relieved of the reports on cover derivatives, foreign mortgage cover or foreign public sector debtors while it uses no such cover, and the relief ends as soon as it does.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File Pfandbrief reports each quarter, or monthly when BaFin orders, electronically
obligations.sourceLabel: Gesetze im Internet, Pfandbrief-Meldeverordnung (PfandMeldeV), BGBl. I S. 1614, § 2 und § 5

titles.en: File Pfandbrief reports each quarter, or monthly when BaFin orders, electronically

summaries.en: The reporting period is the calendar quarter, or the calendar month for the banks and classes covered by an order of BaFin under § 27a Abs. 1 Satz 2 of the Pfandbrief Act, and the reporting date is the last bank working day of the period's last month. The reports are filed within the deadline of § 27a Abs. 1 of the Pfandbrief Act, moving to the next bank working day where it ends on a weekend or holiday, through an electronic channel and in the data formats BaFin publishes on its website.
